changeActorState-actor.label: Actor
changeActorState-actor.tip: Change the state of this actor

add.name: Add
add.tip: Create a state with the specified ID and add it to the actor's state list (If the same state already exists, remove it first)

remove.name: Remove
remove.tip: Remove the state with the specified ID from the actor's state list

remove-instance.name: Remove Instance
remove-instance.tip: Read a state from the state getter and remove it from the actor's state list
